jobs.title: AI Trainer (ML Engineering), Remote - Contract
jobs.description: Role: AI Trainer (ML Engineering) Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contract Time Commitment: 15+ hours per week Schedule: Flexible Required Skills: ML Engineering, AI Training, Programming skills You will use your machine learning expertise to create challenging technical tasks, evaluate model-generated work, identify failures, and establish objective standards for correct solutions. This role is intended for candidates who have already completed substantive AI-training work. What You’ll Work On Create realistic machine learning engineering tasks that challenge advanced AI models. Develop task instructions, reproducible environments, reference solutions, and evaluation criteria. Evaluate model-generated code, experiments, analyses, and technical deliverables. Identify issues involving data leakage, incorrect validation, unstable training, performance, or reproducibility. Required Qualifications Prior paid experience training, evaluating, benchmarking, or improving AI systems. Strong practical proficiency with Python. jobs.description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Executive Assistant , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Prepare correspondence, documents, and reports with flawless grammar and a professional tone. Work through inbound inquiries in the CRM (a customized GoHighLevel). Send follow-up emails, keep records updated, and make sure no lead goes cold.
